He said: So they died. ʿAbd Allāh said: If I were at Rumaylat Miṣr, I would show you their graves, with the description with which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ described them to us.
items.ma-4313: Yazīd and Abū al-Naḍr narrated to us, they said: al-Masʿūdī narrated to us, from al-Walīd ibn al-ʿAyzār, from Abū ʿAmr al-Shaybānī, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Masʿūd, he said: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: O Messenger of Allah, which deeds are most excellent? He said: “The prayer at its appointed time.” He said: I said: Then what, O Messenger of Allah? He said: “Dutifulness to parents.” He said: I said: Then what, O Messenger of Allah? He said: “Jihād in the path of Allah.” He said: Then I fell silent, and had I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for more, he would have given me more.
items.ma-4314: Yazīd — meaning Ibn Hārūn — narrated to us, al-ʿAwwām informed us, Abū Muḥammad, the mawlā of ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, narrated to me, from Abū ʿUbaydah, from ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Any two Muslims from whom three of their children have gone before, who had not reached sin, they will be for them a strong fortress from the Fire.” He said: Abū Dharr said: Two have gone before me, O Messenger of Allah. He said: “And two.” He said: Ubayy Abū al-Mundhir, the master of the reciters, said: One has gone before me, O Messenger of Allah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “And one, and that is at the first shock.”
items.ma-4315: Yazīd narrated to us, al-ʿAwwām ibn Ḥawshab informed us, he said: Abū Isḥāq al-Shaybānī narrated to me, from al-Qāsim ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from his father, from ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The mill of Islam will turn at the head of thirty-five, or thirty-six, or thirty-seven. If they perish, then [it is] the way of the one who perished, and if they remain, their religion will remain for them for seventy years.”
items.ma-4316: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, Shuʿbah informed us, from al-Suddī, from Murrah, from ʿAbd Allāh, (he said: Shuʿbah refused to raise it, and I do not raise it for you) concerning the saying of Allah ﷿: {And whoever intends therein deviation by wrongdoing, We will make him taste of a painful punishment} [al-Ḥajj: 25], he said: If a man were to intend deviation therein while he is in ʿAdan Abyan, Allah would make him taste a painful punishment.
items.ma-4317: Yazīd narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Salamah informed us, from ʿĀṣim, from Zirr, from ʿAbd Allāh, it was said: O Messenger of Allah, how will you recognise those of your ummah whom you have not seen, on the Day of Resurrection? He said: “They are blazed, white-footed, piebald, from the traces of wuḍūʾ.”
items.ma-4318: Yazīd narrated to us, Fuḍayl ibn Marzūq informed us, Abū Salamah al-Juhanī narrated to us, from al-Qāsim ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from his father, from ʿAbd Allāh, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “No servant, when anxiety and grief afflict him, has ever said: O Allah, I am Your servant, the son of Your servant, the son of Your female servant; my forelock is in Your Yad; Your ruling concerning me is carried out, Your decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every name that is Yours, by which You named Yourself, or which You sent down in Your Book, or taught to any of Your creation, or kept exclusively for Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen with You: that You make the Qurʾān the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the clearing of my grief, and the departure of my anxiety — except that Allah ﷿ will remove his anxiety, and replace his grief with joy.” They said: O Messenger of Allah, is it fitting for us to learn these words? He said: “Yes; it is fitting for whoever hears them to learn them.”
items.ma-4319: Yazīd ibn Hārūn narrated to us, Ḥammād ibn Zayd informed us, Farqad al-Sabakhī narrated to us, he said: Jābir ibn Yazīd narrated to us, that he heard Masrūq narrating, from ʿAbd Allāh, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said: “I had forbidden you from visiting the graves, so visit them; and I had forbidden you from keeping the meat of the sacrificial animals beyond three [days], so keep it; and I had forbidden you from the vessels, so make nabīdh in them; and avoid every intoxicant.”
items.ma-4320: Muʿādh ibn Muʿādh narrated to us, he said: Sufyān ibn Saʿīd narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Sāʾib, from Zādhān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Masʿūd, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Indeed Allah ﷿ has angels roaming in the earth, conveying to me the salām from my ummah.”
